tools.name: news_feed_search_news
tools.description: [Read] Search the platform news collection for headlines, news items, and briefing-style result lists. Open-web research with synthesized answers and cited external pages -> web_search. Event catalog with event_id -> get_latest_events.

params.name: query
params.notes: If non-empty, enters similarity mode; tickers are not sent downstream.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Comma-separated tickers; only sent as downstream tickers when query is empty.

params.name: platform
params.notes: Preferred source platform filter, higher priority than platform_type.

params.name: platform_type
params.notes: Legacy platform mapping; ignored when platform exists; 'all' means omit.

params.name: lang
params.notes: MCP local filter only, not sent downstream.

params.name: time_range
params.notes: If present, overrides start_time/end_time. Unknown preset normalizes to 24h. If all time inputs empty, implicit last 7d.

params.name: start_time
params.notes: ISO8601 or Unix sec/ms supported.

params.name: end_time
params.notes: ISO8601 or Unix sec/ms supported; date-only end is treated as end-of-day.

params.name: top_total_score
params.notes: Effective value forced by mode: query non-empty -> 0; query empty -> default 1 unless explicitly 0.

logic: Resolve time_range before explicit dates, default to last 7d; an empty unqueried default window may widen once to 30d. Apply optional language/entity filters and sort by descending time only for top_total_score=0 with sort_by=time.

errors.when: start_time/end_time cannot be parsed or start_time > end_time
API config missing

tools.name: news_feed_search_ugc
tools.description: [Read] Reddit/Discord/Telegram/YouTube-style UGC: a non-empty query searches relevant content; coin without query selects coin-related content. Both empty is invalid. X/Twitter narrative -> search_x; headlines -> search_news. Not macro economic statistics or a structured event list; use get_latest_events for events.

input_rules.required_policy: query and coin cannot both be empty; may combine query with coin

params.name: query
params.notes: If non-empty, uses vector API branch.

params.name: coin
params.notes: If query is empty, coin is required to select coin-related content.

logic: Require query or coin. A query performs text-based search with the supplied filters; without query, coin selects coin-related content. Both branches return the same public result fields, sorted and capped as requested.

errors.when: query and coin are both empty
The requested search capability is unavailable: text search for a non-empty query, or coin-related search when query is empty.

tools.name: news_feed_search_x
tools.description: [Read] Search and analyze X/Twitter discussions for a topic, with tweet-level evidence and cited posts. Aggregate social mood, sentiment score, or positive/negative split -> get_social_sentiment. Open-web pages -> web_search. Multi-platform social search -> search_ugc.

input_rules.required_policy: No field is unconditionally required, but an empty query in live X-search mode returns an empty result.

params.name: query
params.notes: Topic text for X discussion search.

params.name: time_range
params.notes: Preferred recency window; when provided it overrides days.

params.name: days
params.notes: For live X search: lookback days when time_range is omitted. Omitted or <=0 is treated as 1 (24h). The effective default is 1 even where older schema text states 7.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Only used in platform fallback path (mapped to search_news style).

params.name: platform
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: platform_type
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: lang
params.notes: Controls the X-search answer language and the language filter when the general-news fallback is used.

params.name: start_time
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: end_time
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: sort_by
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: top_total_score
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: page
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

params.name: similarity_score
params.notes: Platform fallback only.

logic: Reject simultaneous non-empty allowed_handles and excluded_handles. Resolve dates from time_range (1h/24h use one day, 7d uses seven days) or otherwise days. If live X search is not configured, use the configured general-news fallback when enabled; otherwise config_load_failed. Preserve stable default sentiment fields.

errors.when: allowed_handles and excluded_handles are both provided
Live X search is unavailable and fallback is disabled, or the requested search capability is otherwise unavailable.

tools.name: news_feed_web_search
tools.description: [Read] Search the open web and return a synthesized answer with cited external pages. Built-in headline lookup, news-item search, or briefing-style news list -> search_news. X/Twitter-only discussion or tweet evidence -> search_x.
logic: Normalize mode/time_range/lang/limit; return summary/key_points/cited_sources with normalized citations and an items list. brief truncates the summary to about 100 characters.

errors.when: query is empty
The web-search capability or required access is unavailable.

tools.name: news_feed_get_exchange_announcements
tools.description: [Read] Venue-published exchange notices: listings, delistings, maintenance. Media rumors or general crypto headlines -> search_news.

params.name: exchange
params.notes: Used as platform fallback if platform is empty.

params.name: platform
params.notes: Wins over exchange for downstream platform param.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Only forwarded when >0.

params.name: from
params.notes: Unix sec lower bound; local post-filter also applied.

params.name: to
params.notes: Unix sec upper bound; local post-filter also applied.

logic: Return exchange announcements with selected parameters; platform takes precedence over exchange. Accept the documented compatible response-list shapes, apply from/to filtering, and sort newest first.

errors.when: API config missing

tools.name: news_feed_get_social_sentiment
tools.description: [Read] Aggregate per-coin social sentiment for a time range: overall sentiment, positive/negative split, mention count, and sample tweets. X/Twitter post search or tweet-level evidence -> search_x. Multi-platform social thread search -> search_ugc.

params.name: time_range
params.notes: Invalid values are normalized to 24h.

logic: Normalize coin/time_range; return overall_sentiment, normalized sentiment_label, mention_count, distribution and top_tweets based on the available sentiment data.

errors.when: API config missing

tools.name: news_feed_get_mention_burst
tools.description: [Read] Get a coin's 24h multi-platform social mention burst signal, growth, sentiment direction, platform breakdown, and display eligibility. For general sentiment ratios and sample tweets use get_social_sentiment; for individual social discussions use search_ugc.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Trimmed and normalized to uppercase. No coin-dictionary validation is performed; unknown or no-data tickers may return an empty result with hide_reason=no_data.

params.name: platforms
params.notes: Comma-separated. Supported: all, gate_square, binance_square, twitter, telegram, youtube, reddit, discord. all cannot be combined with another platform.

logic: Normalize coin, window and the selected platforms.
Return current and previous mention counts, weighted growth, sentiment direction, display color and per-platform breakdown.
hide_reason explains no_data, insufficient_baseline, insufficient_sample or not_burst; preserve nullable numeric fields rather than replacing missing values with zero.

errors.when: coin is empty, window is not 24h, or platforms contains an unsupported value
the upstream social API call fails

tools.name: news_feed_get_hot_topics
tools.description: [Read] Get the top 2-4 social discussion themes for one coin over the latest 4h, including direction, influence, sentiment, platforms, and representative evidence posts. For arbitrary social search use search_ugc; for X/Twitter-only narrative research use search_x.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Trimmed and normalized to uppercase. No coin-dictionary validation is performed; unknown or no-data tickers may return an empty result with hide_reason=no_data.

params.name: platforms
params.notes: Comma-separated. Supported: all, gate_square, binance_square, twitter, telegram, youtube, reddit, discord. all cannot be combined with another platform.

logic: Normalize coin, the fixed 4h window, topic limit and selected platforms.
Return qualified themes with direction, titles, summary, influence, sentiment, platforms and representative evidence posts.
Fewer than two qualified themes returns an empty topics array with a hide_reason.

errors.when: coin is empty, window is not 4h, limit is outside 2-4, or platforms contains an unsupported value
the upstream social API call fails

tools.name: news_events_get_latest_events
tools.description: [Read] Filtered event list or timeline; each row includes event_id. One event_id detail -> get_event_detail. Headline/news feed -> search_news.

params.name: event_type
params.notes: all or empty means no type filter.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Comma-separated; expanded to variant terms for related_coins/symbols filtering.

params.name: time_range
params.notes: Mutually exclusive with start_time/end_time.

params.name: start_time
params.notes: Mutually exclusive with time_range.

params.name: end_time
params.notes: Mutually exclusive with time_range.

params.name: cursor
params.notes: Reserved; currently unused and does not enable pagination.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Omitted or <=0 -> 20; >100 -> invalid_size.

logic: Validate limit default 20 maximum 100 and the time_range enum; time_range cannot coexist with explicit dates. Apply event-type/coin/time filters, newest first. With no time parameters use the documented service policy. Return total/count/items.

errors.when: time_range invalid or mixed with start/end
limit > 100
Event retrieval fails; the client receives internal.

tools.name: news_events_get_event_detail
tools.description: [Read] Full detail for one event_id only. Filtered event list or timeline -> get_latest_events. Unknown id returns not found.

params.name: event_id
params.notes: Cannot contain unsafe chars like quotes/semicolon/backslash.

logic: Validate non-empty safe event_id and retrieve matching details. Return resource_not_found when it does not exist, preserving the public event_id context.

errors.when: event_id empty, too long, or illegal characters
event_id is valid but no matching event exists
Event retrieval fails; the client receives internal.

tools.name: news_events_explain_market_move
tools.description:
[Read] Explain what drove a crypto asset's price move in a given time window.
Returns a concise summary from current web evidence, the latest high-priority events, supporting event-feed items, and data-completeness status.
This tool aggregates evidence; the downstream agent performs the final attribution reasoning.

params.name: query
params.notes: User question, e.g. why did BTC surge; whitespace-trimmed; empty rejected.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Target symbol; whitespace is trimmed and empty input returns missing_coin. Known aliases and full names are normalized to a standard ticker; unknown aliases are preserved rather than rejected.

params.name: time_range
params.notes: Only 30m/1h/2h/4h/24h are preserved (case-insensitive); any other value, including empty or 7d, normalizes to 2h. Selects the recency of web evidence and the event-feed window described in logic.

params.name: mode
params.notes: Reserved. Accepted values are normalized but currently do not affect explanation results.

params.name: lang
params.notes: Reserved. Accepted values are normalized but currently do not affect explanation results.

logic: Validate query/coin and normalize time_range/lang/mode. Combine current public web evidence with up to two relevant event-feed items. Keep 30m/1h/2h/4h/24h (case insensitive); other values including empty and 7d normalize to 2h. Event-feed windows map 30m/1h to 1h and 2h/4h/24h to 24h. Deduplicate evidence by URL then title, keep the highest relevance and sort descending. Preserve summary, evidence timestamps/scores and completeness/missing_sources values. If both sources return no evidence and none is missing, report No relevant events found.

errors.when: query is empty after trim
coin is empty after trim
ExplainMarketMove returns error (current implementation usually returns success with partial empty slices)

tools.name: news_events_get_market_move_report
tools.description: [Read] Query a stored market-move attribution report by symbol, optional report_id, or optional event_id. Lookup priority is report_id > event_id > latest report for symbol. Returned event/report timestamps are UTC0 unless the field name ends in _utc8. This tool never requests report regeneration and does not expose is_make_new.

params.name: symbol
params.notes: Trimmed and normalized to uppercase by the MCP service.

params.name: report_id
params.notes: Exact stored-report lookup; takes priority over event_id.

params.name: event_id
params.notes: Returns the latest report for this event when report_id is omitted. Omit both IDs for the latest symbol report.

logic: Retrieve an existing stored report for the normalized symbol; never request generation. Only symbol and non-empty report_id/event_id are sent. Lookup priority is report_id > event_id > symbol. Preserve report status, Markdown report_info, evidence, market-move fields, UTC0 timestamps and explicit +08:00 UTC8-window fields. Legacy serialized evidence is returned in the same structured evidence shape.

errors.when: symbol is empty or longer than 20 characters; CLI JSON fallback explicitly includes is_make_new
The stored-report capability is not configured.
The stored-report request, response decoding, or business response fails.

tools.name: news_events_list_market_move_reports
tools.description: [Read] List stored market-move attribution reports for one symbol, filtering by an inclusive UTC0 updated_at range and sorting results by event_time descending. Reports may be updated after their market event, so updated_at can be later than event_time. Timezone-less inputs are UTC0; inputs with an explicit offset are converted to UTC0 before the read-only lookup.

input_rules.required_policy: symbol, start_time, and end_time are required

params.name: symbol
params.notes: Trimmed and normalized to uppercase by the MCP service.

params.name: start_time
params.notes: Inclusive lower bound for report updated_at in UTC0; ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. No timezone means UTC0; an explicit offset is converted to UTC0.

params.name: end_time
params.notes: Inclusive upper bound for report updated_at in UTC0; ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. No timezone means UTC0; an explicit offset is converted to UTC0; cannot precede start_time.

params.name: limit
params.notes: 0 has the same behavior as omitted and defaults to 20; nonzero values must be 1-100.

logic: Validate symbol and inclusive updated_at bounds; timezone-less inputs are UTC0 and explicit offsets convert to UTC0. Require start_time<=end_time; omitted/zero limit normalizes to 20. Read existing reports without a generation parameter. Return ready/generating/not_found/failed status, trace_id, reports sorted by event_time descending and duration_ms. updated_at may be later than event_time, so filter by updated_at rather than event time.

errors.when: required input is missing, datetime is invalid, start_time > end_time, or CLI JSON fallback includes is_make_new
limit is negative or greater than 100
The stored-report capability is not configured.
The stored-report request, response decoding, or business response fails.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_volume_delta_ranking
tools.description: [Read] Daily venue/overall ranking by volume delta (UTC rank_date). Optional venue[], exact category filter, and status active/closed/resolved/all (default active). Returns not_implemented when the ranking capability is unavailable.

params.name: date_utc
params.notes: Empty or omitted -> current UTC date.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Omitted or null -> 20; explicit <=0 -> invalid_size; >100 -> invalid_size.

params.name: venue
params.notes: Each element must be allowed; empty or omitted -> no venue filter (all venues). Multiple values match any of the supplied venues exactly.

params.name: category
params.notes: Free-text exact category filter; no server-side enum check. Empty or omitted -> no filter. Non-empty and not 'all' (case-sensitive) -> exact match. Unknown values -> empty overall, not invalid_param.

params.name: status
params.notes: Empty or omitted -> active. 'all' -> no status filter; otherwise match the selected status exactly.

logic: Validate limit default 20 in 1..100, YYYY-MM-DD date_utc, supported venues polymarket/predict_fun and status active/closed/resolved/all (default active). category is a trimmed exact free-text filter; unknown categories return empty results. Rank by volume_delta_usd_today descending with ties broken by venue_event_id then rank_no. Preserve overall/by_venue/generated_at/duration_ms/partial/source_data_status/excluded_reasons; null volume_delta values do not by themselves remove matching rows.

errors.when: date_utc not YYYY-MM-DD; any non-empty venue not polymarket/predict_fun; status not in active/closed/resolved/all
limit <= 0 or limit > 100
Ranking retrieval fails; the client receives internal.
The ranking capability is unavailable; this placeholder returns not_implemented.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_fastest_rising_ranking
tools.description: [Read] Daily venue/overall ranking by probability rise (UTC rank_date). Optional venue[], category, and status match volume_delta ranking. Drops rows missing open_mid_probability_utc or probability_delta_today. Returns not_implemented when the ranking capability is unavailable.

params.name: date_utc
params.notes: Empty or omitted -> current UTC date.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Same as volume_delta: omitted -> 20; <=0 or >100 -> invalid_size.

params.name: venue
params.notes: Each element must be allowed; empty or omitted -> no venue filter. Multiple values -> terms filter (exact).

params.name: category
params.notes: Same category behavior as volume_delta: free-text exact match, no enum validation. Empty or omitted -> no filter; 'all' -> no filter; any other value -> exact category match.

params.name: status
params.notes: Same semantics as volume_delta tool: empty -> active; 'all' -> no status filter.

logic: Use the same filters and validation as volume-delta ranking, ordered by probability_delta_today descending with ties broken by venue_event_id then rank_no. Exclude rows missing open_mid_probability_utc or probability_delta_today and preserve their completeness/exclusion reasons. Return the same ranking response family.

errors.when: date_utc not YYYY-MM-DD; any non-empty venue not polymarket/predict_fun; status not in active/closed/resolved/all
limit <= 0 or limit > 100
Ranking retrieval fails; the client receives internal.
The ranking capability is unavailable; this placeholder returns not_implemented.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_market_orderbook
tools.description: [Read] Live current order book only (mode=current). depth 1-20 (default 20). polymarket uses market_id=venue_market_id; unavailable market lookup returns not_implemented. Returns yes/no books: one failed side is partial, both failed sides fail the tool. predict_fun uses its official numeric market_id, not a polymarket ID; unavailable access returns partial_not_configured without a request. API/parse failures return partial rather than internal; 404 returns resource_not_found. Rejects history/granularity/time/page_token. snapshot_time/book_levels/best_* may be null when partial. Event list/signal -> search_events / get_event_signal.

params.name: venue
params.notes: Trimmed; must be in whitelist.

params.name: market_id
params.notes: polymarket: its venue_market_id; requires available market lookup. predict_fun: official numeric market ID (e.g. 356640), not a polymarket venue_market_id.

params.name: depth
params.notes: Levels returned in yes_bids/yes_asks (top-N from each side).

params.name: mode
params.notes: history rejected; empty treated as current.

params.name: granularity
params.notes: Unsupported; non-empty -> invalid_param.

params.name: start_time
params.notes: Unsupported; non-empty -> invalid_param.

params.name: end_time
params.notes: Unsupported; non-empty -> invalid_param.

params.name: page_token
params.notes: Unsupported; non-empty -> invalid_param.

logic: Support current books only; reject history/granularity/time/page_token. Validate venue/market_id/depth/mode. A complete response may be cached briefly; partial responses are not cached. polymarket uses its venue market ID and returns yes/no books; one failed side is partial and both failed sides fail the operation. predict_fun uses its official numeric ID; unavailable authorization returns partial_not_configured without a request, API/parse failures return partial with the documented missing_sources, and 404 returns resource_not_found. Preserve snapshot_time/book_levels/source_api/source_data_status/duration_ms and complement-derived no-side prices.

errors.when: venue/market_id empty; venue not polymarket/predict_fun; depth < 1 or > 20; mode=history or other unsupported mode; granularity/start_time/end_time/page_token set
obHTTP nil; polymarket CLOB base URL empty on fetch
The order-book capability is unavailable, or polymarket market lookup is unavailable.
polymarket market lookup fails; the client receives internal.
polymarket CLOB: both yes and no book fetches fail (single-side fail -> partial, no tool error)
polymarket: no market hit or missing yes/no token_id; predict_fun: HTTP 404 market_id=… venue=predict_fun
predict_fun: empty API key, 401/unauthorized, or API/parse failure -> partial + missing_sources (predict_fun_not_configured|predict_fun_orderbook_failed); not internal

tools.name: news_prediction_search_events
tools.description: [Read] Search prediction events, returning one latest result per event. At least one of query, coin, or category is required. Default sort_by=recently_listed; status defaults active (coin alone with no query/category -> all). Coin matching can legitimately return zero rows when coin associations are unavailable. category accepts the declared enum (crypto_price, sports, ...). with_markets attaches market summaries. Single event_ref detail -> get_event_signal; live order book -> get_market_orderbook.

input_rules.required_policy: at least one of query, coin, or category is required

params.name: query
params.notes: Whitespace is trimmed. Query matches event-title text; a query containing only digits also matches the venue event ID exactly.

params.name: coin
params.notes: Known coin aliases are normalized to a standard ticker. If status is omitted, use all only when coin is provided and query/category are both empty; coin+category without query still defaults to active. Coin associations can be absent, in which case a coin filter can legitimately return no matches.

params.name: category
params.notes: Filters by the selected event category; market-category associations may also be used when available.

params.name: status
params.default: active when omitted (except coin-only with no query/category -> all)
params.notes: Omitted -> active unless query is empty, coin is provided and category is empty, in which case all. Coin+category without query still defaults to active. Results reflect the selected event status and expose normalized status_tags.

params.name: venue
params.notes: Each non-empty element is validated; blank elements are skipped. Matches the selected venues.

params.name: sort_by
params.notes: attention sorts by attention; volume|volume_delta_today by 24h volume; liquidity by liquidity; recently_listed by listing recency; probability_change by the absolute 6h probability change. If preferred sort metadata is unavailable, a supported fallback ordering is used.

params.name: limit
params.notes: Values <1 or >100 are invalid. Returns at most limit events; pagination can report whether more results exist.

params.name: page_token
params.notes: Base64 JSON {sort_by, search_after}; invalid decode or sort_by mismatch (when both sides non-empty) -> invalid_param.

params.name: with_markets
params.notes: When true, attach available market summaries; when false, omit markets. If attachment is skipped or fails, missing_sources includes markets_index_not_configured|markets_attach_failed and partial remains false.

logic: Require query, coin or category and validate the declared enums/bounds. Default limit 20 and sort recently_listed. status defaults active except coin alone defaults all. Query matches title text or a numeric event ID; category and venues filter the public event results. Return one latest result per event, stable venue/event tie breaks and cursor pagination. Coin filters can legitimately return no matches. with_markets controls optional market summaries; attach failure preserves events and reports documented missing_sources. Preserve normalized statuses, public category/probability fields, next_page_token and duration_ms; failures use the documented internal error without storage names.

errors.when: query/coin/category all empty; category/sort_by/status/venue invalid; page_token invalid or sort_by mismatch
limit < 1 or > 100
Event search still fails after supported sort fallbacks; the client receives internal without detailed storage diagnostics.
The event-search capability is unavailable; this placeholder returns not_implemented.

tools.name: news_prediction_get_event_signal
tools.description: [Read] Single event signal by event_ref (venue:venue_event_id). window 1h/24h/7d (default 24h). Returns outcome_probabilities, volume_flow, directional_context, and optional markets[] (default include_markets=true). depth_summary is always null; use get_market_orderbook for live depth. daily_ranking is included when ranking data is available. Discover event_ref -> search_events. include_orderbook_summary is ignored.

params.name: event_ref
params.notes: Split on the first ':' into venue and venue_event_id (the ID may contain further colons). Normalize to venue:venue_event_id. Venue must be polymarket or predict_fun.

params.name: window
params.notes: Case-insensitive. Selects the signal time window. A 1h request may use an additional 3h lookback to locate a fallback result.

params.name: venue
params.notes: Optional; each non-empty value must equal event_ref venue or invalid_param.

params.name: include_markets
params.notes: Omitted/null -> true. Returns available market summaries, using a supplementary source if the signal has none. false omits markets[]. Invalid serialized market data -> partial + markets_json_invalid.

params.name: include_orderbook_summary
params.notes: Deprecated; accepted but does not affect the result.

logic: Require event_ref=venue:event_id, split on the first colon and preserve any additional colons in the ID. Accept window 1h|24h|7d, default 24h, case insensitive. Return the latest available signal in the window; a 1h fallback can report signal_window_fallback. Preserve event_identity, timestamps/status, outcome_probabilities, directional_context, volume_flow and optional daily_ranking/markets. include_markets omitted/null defaults true; false omits markets. Unusable supplementary markets preserve documented partial/missing-source codes. depth_summary remains null; use get_market_orderbook for live depth. include_orderbook_summary remains ignored. No matching signal returns resource_not_found.

errors.when: event_ref empty; not venue:id shape; venue not allowed; window not 1h/24h/7d; venue[] filter mismatches event_ref venue
Signal retrieval fails; the client receives internal.
no document in window (detail: event_ref=venue:id)
The event-signal capability is unavailable; this placeholder returns not_implemented.
